caveat: Staff positions come from the same scaffold as the movement data. A camera sees people, not job titles -- separating staff from shoppers on real footage needs uniforms, a badge or a roster joined on shift times, and the accuracy of that step caps everything on this screen. No individual employee is identified.
insight: Kids spent the most time with shoppers in it and nobody serving. Sections with nobody assigned by name tend to end up here, because whoever is free is usually at the till.

actions.todo: Nobody is assigned to Kids. Give it to one person by name for a week -- not 'whoever is free', because whoever is free is always at the till.
